types.name: Bank
docs: Base-layer escrow for staked rooms. Program-owned so it can pay out directly.

fields.name: outstanding
docs: Stakes held for tickets not yet used or refunded. Counted, not read from the balance,
because anyone can send SOL to any account.

fields.name: tickets
docs: Ticket accounts that still exist. A room can only close once all are gone, or the
used ones could never hand their rent back (closing a ticket needs its bank).

types.name: Board
docs: Global leaderboard on the base layer: staked nights only, updated by a Magic Action after each one.

fields.name: earned
docs: lamports won from staked pots

types.name: Daily
docs: The daily challenge's public board, delegated to the rollup so it costs nothing to update.
Today's seed lives in a separate sealed account; yesterday's is published here.

types.name: NightRecord
docs: One staked night, as logged by settle. Seats are 0-7; `wallets` holds each human seat's payout
wallet (default for bots and empty seats). `feed_killer`/`feed_victim` list the kills in order,
255 = the zone.

types.name: Prize
docs: The daily prize, on the base layer (never delegated). Settle of every night at a PRIZE_STAKE
table adds 2% of the pot and each staker's games, stake and winnings for the UTC day. When a
new day starts (the first settle or claim after midnight UTC), the day closes: the wallet with
the highest net profit (won - staked) among those with PRIZE_MIN_GAMES nights wins the pot and
can claim it until the next day closes. No winner, or not claimed by then: it goes to the
treasury. The account's lamports are its rent + `pot` + `last_prize` (while unclaimed).

fields.name: day
docs: UTC day being counted (unix seconds / 86400); 0 before the first night

fields.name: pot
docs: lamports set aside for today so far

fields.name: last_claimed
docs: 1 once the last day's prize is paid (or there was none)

fields.name: key
docs: the staker's payout wallet (the same key the leaderboard uses)

types.name: Room
docs: Public lobby + scoreboard. Readable by anyone holding a TEE auth token.
Holds nothing that would leak a hidden position.

fields.name: start_slot
docs: ER slot when the match went live. In a staked lobby (where it is otherwise unused) it holds
the unix time after which the table may start: 0 until two stakers are seated, pushed back
by every new staker. See `arm_staked_start` / `staked_start_ok`.

fields.name: cfg
docs: room config set by its creator: bits 0-7 = seats (2..8, 0 = 8), bit 8 = unlisted, bits 9-10 = bot level, bits 13-15 = night modifier, bit 16 = duos

fields.name: stake_deadline
docs: staked rooms: earliest ticket expiry among those seated. Free rooms in the lobby: unix time
the lobby opened (0 = unknown), see `lobby_overdue`.

types.name: Ticket
docs: Base-layer proof that a seat paid the stake for a given match.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: After this the stake can be refunded even if the room never settled.

fields.name: consumed
docs: Set by settle: this stake went into a pot. Must stay the last field (see `use_ticket`).
